title: Season Tip #4: the 5-minute start
cta: Executive Functioning Workbook for Teens · link in bio

copy.caption: Dreading term-end work? Start with 5 minutes: pick one task, set a 5-minute timer, then stop or keep going. Five minutes now beats a panic later. Executive Functioning Workbook for Teens (30 short sessions, 6 skills): link in bio.
